scenarios.name: Localise Ford parts to USMCA content
scenarios.description: Re-source castings and forgings into North America so Ford's parts meet USMCA regional value content and stay duty-free under a parts tariff. A localisation cost per piece replaces the tariff. This is the structural answer to the first scenario rather than a forecast of one.

scenarios.name: Aluminium surcharge doubles
scenarios.description: The per-kg aluminium surcharge doubles, as it did in 2022, on every aluminium-intensive part family. The move is largest on heavy, low-value parts and in the aftermarket, where garages respond to price.

scenarios.name: US 25% tariff on Mexican-built parts
scenarios.description: A 25% duty on Ford's parts built in San Luis Potosí, against the USMCA zero they enter at today. Ford buys direct, so Vectron's price is nearly all of the delivered cost and the tariff has no margin or tax layer to hide behind. Ford's build schedule barely moves; the cost lands as a commercial negotiation.
